## Placeholders to fix before buying

**7 of 141 purchased lines are placeholders** (practice DG-07, docs/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md key rule: a purchased part must be a real, orderable product - maker, maker part number, seller - drawn from the maker's CAD and rated from the maker's datasheet). The design is **not buildable** while any remains. They are named `PLACEHOLDER-<sku>` in BOM.md and bom.csv.

| BOM line | Qty | State | Why | Replace with (real part or search) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PLACEHOLDER-HEATER-HYDRA-SQ1451144-210x210-24V-200W` | 1 | placeholder | ratings without a maker's source: electrical.max_temp_c | measure the thickness on arrival; fallback Keenovo SKU 10133 200 x 200 (China, $43.28, 2-6 weeks) |
| `PLACEHOLDER-CTRL-OCTOPUS-V1.1` | 1 | placeholder | ratings without a maker's source: electrical.logic_w, electrical.max_ambient_c, electrical.output_resistance_ohm, electrical.thermistor_pullup_ohm | BTT schematic / manual figures for logic power, max ambient, fan-output resistance and the thermistor pull-up (now typical values) |
| `PLACEHOLDER-NEMA17-48-LEADSCREW-TR8x2-330-AB4` | 3 | placeholder | ratings without a maker's source: efficiency, rotor_inertia_gcm2 | StepperOnline: rotor inertia and screw efficiency (not on drawing A4003) |
| `PLACEHOLDER-RESET-PUSHBUTTON-22MM-1NO (the G9SE-201 manual reset button, T33/T34; product to name, beside the e-stop)` | 1 | placeholder | BOM-only line with no maker, maker part number, seller | to be found |
| `PLACEHOLDER-TR8x2-INTEGRAL-17E19S1684AB4-330RA` | 3 | placeholder | ratings without a maker's source: efficiency | StepperOnline: rotor inertia and screw efficiency (not on drawing A4003) |
| `PLACEHOLDER-EXTRUDER-E3D-ROTO` | 1 | placeholder | ratings without a maker's source: electrical.max_surface_temp_c, electrical.phase_inductance_mh, electrical.step_angle_deg | to be found |
| `PLACEHOLDER-HOTEND-REVO-24V-40W` | 1 | placeholder | ratings without a maker's source: electrical.resistance_ohm_23c, electrical.volts | to be found |

## Licence note

Purchased parts appear as BOM lines only. No vendor CAD is copied into this package: `cad/`, `dxf/` and `stl/` hold the design's own custom parts. E3D's reference CAD (CC BY-NC-ND) is visible only as part of the whole-machine and stage pictures in `images/`, which are renders of the assembly.
